name: Hotel Meiko (Yomase Rising Sun Hotel)
name_local: よませライジングサンホテル ホテル明幸
short_description: Ski-in/ski-out hotel forming the base centre of Yomase Onsen ski resort — lift tickets, rentals and restaurants all on the ground floor.
long_description: Hotel Meiko sits literally at the entrance to Mt. KOSHA Yomase Onsen ski resort: the resort's base centre 'Faro' is housed on the hotel's east side, with a rental shop, Yamazaki Y-Shop convenience store, coin lockers and lift-ticket counter. The 41-room hotel offers natural hot spring baths (Meisei-no-yu indoor daiyokujo and an outdoor bath with views over Zenkoji Plain), yukata, and full-board plans with a set-menu Japanese dinner and buffet breakfast. Restaurant La Mule also opens as a slope-side lunch spot in winter. Ski storage, coin laundry and free shuttles from Yudanaka Station are provided. The most operationally convenient base in Yomase.

name: Hotel Selan
name_local: よませ温泉 ホテルセラン
short_description: Panoramic-view onsen hotel 2 minutes' walk from Yomase ski resort, known for spectacular sunsets over Zenkoji Plain.
long_description: Hotel Selan stands at the foot of Mt. Takayashiro with sweeping views across Zenkoji Plain, the Northern Alps, and the Kita-Shiga Highlands — views good enough to earn the hotel's surroundings a place on Nagano's Sunset-Spot 100 list. The 60-room property (15 Japanese-style, 45 Japanese-Western mix) operates a large 24-hour indoor bath and two open-air baths (including a reservable private rotenburo). Meal plans feature Shinshu rustic cuisine — shabu-shabu with Miyuki pork, Shinshu premium beef, and seasonal local produce. Also functions as a day-trip onsen facility. Shuttle from Yudanaka Station available; basic English spoken at front desk.

name: Resort Inn Cairn (Yomase Onsen)
name_local: よませ温泉 リゾートイン・ケルン
short_description: Compact 20-room ski lodge inside the Yomase ski area with communal hot-spring bath, ski drying room, and coin laundry.
long_description: Resort Inn Cairn is a no-frills ski lodge positioned within the Yomase Onsen ski resort boundary, offering direct access to the slopes without a car. The 20 rooms are all Japanese-style tatami, non-smoking; futon self-service. Facilities are ski-practical: ski drying room, coin laundry, large communal bath (Yomase Onsen hot spring), vending machines and Wi-Fi throughout. The lodge caters to ski groups and is accessible by shuttle from Yudanaka Station (pre-booking required). Yukata not provided as standard but available on request from front desk.
address: Yomase Onsen ski resort area, Yamanouchi-machi, Shimotakai-gun, Nagano 381-0405

name: Chateautel Kitashiga
short_description: Budget-friendly ski lodge 3 minutes' walk from X-JAM Takai Fuji, popular with student and young-group ski trips; all-you-can-eat Shinshu miso-nabe dinner.
long_description: Chateautel Kitashiga is a compact Western-style pension-lodge in an old English manor aesthetic, squarely aimed at the Japanese student/young group ski market. The 'ski-yado' format is standard: shared baths (15:00–23:00), set dinner (Shinshu miso nabe all-you-can-eat, 60 minutes), and Japanese-Western set breakfast. Rooms range from twin/family to larger ski-team dorms (2–8 persons). Located 3 minutes' walk to X-JAM Takai Fuji lifts and 3 minutes to the Seven-Eleven. Wi-Fi throughout; free parking (7 cars). No yukata provided; bathrobe rental available (¥300). Often booked through Japanese ski-tour operators.
amenities: 3 min walk to X-JAM Takai Fuji lifts

name: Kitashiga Grand Hotel
name_local: 北志賀グランドホテル
short_description: Large 110-room ski-in/ski-out budget hotel at the foot of Kitashiga Komaruyama ski area; catering to groups and ski clubs.
long_description: Kitashiga Grand Hotel is the largest property in the upper Yomase/Kita-Shiga area at 110 rooms, positioned zero-minutes' walk from the Kitashiga Komaruyama ski area lifts. Its size and layout make it the default choice for large Japanese ski-club groups, schools, and corporate parties looking for an all-in package. Rooms are functional and dated but spacious; TripAdvisor reviewers note good value for ski-focused guests. Amenities include a bar/lounge, free parking, ski rentals and ski school on site. English, Japanese and Korean are spoken. Reviews are mixed on service and room quality, but value for ski access is consistently praised.

name: Kitashiga Holiday Inn
short_description: Mid-size ski hotel at Kitashiga (Ryuoo Ski Park area) with two on-site restaurants including the acclaimed 'Yamanomi' soba dining room.
long_description: Kitashiga Holiday Inn is situated in the upper Kita-Shiga part of the Yomase area, close to Ryuoo Ski Park. The hotel houses two restaurants: 'Yamanomi' (石臼挽き蕎麦香房 山の実 / Tabelog Award winner, soba) and 'Holiday Inn Dining' — the soba restaurant is open to non-guests in summer/autumn and operates as a winter slope-side dining room. Rooms include twin and family types. Reviewers report rooms as basic but clean; the ski access and meal quality are cited as highlights. The hotel is a quieter, more remote option than properties near the lower Yomase base.
amenities: two on-site restaurants (Yamanomi soba + Holiday Inn Dining)

name: Petit Hotel Paddington House
name_local: ペットと泊まれる温泉 プチホテル パディントンハウス
short_description: Old-England-styled pet-friendly onsen hotel in Yomase — notable for a dedicated dog rotenburo, dog run, and owner-chef's seasonal menu.
long_description: Paddington House is a distinctive property in the Yomase area: an Old England-styled petit hotel that allows guests to stay with dogs and cats, complete with a dedicated canine open-air hot spring (100% natural Yomase Onsen, 24-hour access), a dog run, agility course, and a lounge and restaurant that are pet-welcoming. Human guests enjoy the same natural alkaline single-spring onsen. The owner-chef prepares creative dinners using local seasonal produce and Shinshu beef. Given its niche focus, it attracts a different demographic than most ski lodges in the area — though ski access to Yomase and X-JAM is still within a short drive.
address: Kita-Shiga Kogen Yomase Onsen, Yamanouchi-machi, Shimotakai-gun, Nagano 381-0405
amenities: owner-chef dinner (Shinshu beef, seasonal local produce)

name: Guest House Tesoro Okushiga
name_local: 自然と繋がる小さな宿 テゾーロ奥志賀
short_description: Intimate 9-room guesthouse at 1,500 m altitude with creative farm-to-table dinners, floor heating, and a dedicated wax room; 2-minute walk to ski lifts.
long_description: Tesoro is a small, thoughtfully run guesthouse at the highest point of the Yomase postal area (Okushiga Kogen, 1,500 m), operated by a family who prioritise ingredients from North Shinano farmers and a genuine guesthouse atmosphere. Dinner menus combine Japanese, Western, and Chinese techniques with local vegetables, Shiga Kogen Beer, regional sake, and an impressive whisky/wine list. The nine rooms (six western, one Japanese, two with private bathroom) all have floor heating and washlet toilets. The wax/drying room is equipped with a wax table. Lift access is a 2-minute walk via a dedicated walkway. The address is technically in the Yomase postcode but the accommodation is closer to Okushiga Kogen ski area and is relevant for guests wanting upper-mountain access.
amenities: outdoor deck + tree tent + slack lines
creative dinner with local sake/beer pairings
nearest_mountain: Okushiga Kogen Ski Area / Shiga Kogen

name: Hotel Cascade Kitashiga
name_local: 北志賀高原 ホテルカスケード
short_description: Smaller Yomase hotel with panoramic lounge views of the night scene over Zenkoji Plain; hot spring onsen on site.
long_description: Hotel Cascade is a mid-size property in the central Yomase area with a well-regarded lounge offering views over the Zenkoji Plain at night — a highlight cited in local reviews. It operates a natural hot-spring onsen (sources confirm 100% natural water at ~100°C), a large communal bath ('Shiga-no-yu'), private rental bath ('Sakura-no-yu'), and shared external baths (Oyu, Kakke-no-yu, Heiwa-no-yu) nearby. Ski and board rentals are available. The property is at a similar price point to Hotel Selan and appeals to guests seeking slightly quieter surroundings while keeping easy access to Yomase Onsen ski area.
